request: API p99 latency rose from 180 ms to 900 ms on 12 September. We upgraded the database on 11 September and rolled out a feature flag on 12 September. What caused it?
known_answer: The 12 September flag turned on synchronous request logging to object storage in eu-west only; only eu-west latency rose. The 11 September database upgrade touched all regions and changed nothing.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client

files.flags.log: 2026-09-12 09:00 enable audit_log_sync=true region=eu-west (writes each request to object storage before responding)
files.db-upgrade.md: 2026-09-11: Postgres 15.6 -> 15.8, all regions, no config change.
